title: When the Vehicle Is Stuck: Noticing It Without Crying Wolf, a Ladder of Things to Try Per Vehicle, and Knowing When to Give Up

questions.question: What are the two halves of the stuck test?
options: Commanded to move for a whole window, and moved less than a distance
Stopped for a whole window, wherever it is
Off the path, and not moving
Commanded to move, and moving slowly
questions.explanation: A vehicle that is not being asked to move is not stuck. One asked to move that covers less than 0.1 m in 3 s is.

questions.question: A vehicle commanded to stop for 10 s was flagged how many times?
options: Once, after 3 s
Three times
Every tick
questions.explanation: It was commanded to stop, so the first half of the test was false throughout.

questions.question: The snagged vehicle finished in 23.5 s on which attempt?
options: At the first attempt, by waiting
After 3 attempts, by spinning
After 2 attempts, the second by backing up
It did not finish
questions.explanation: Waiting changed nothing. Backing up to 2.6 m freed it, and it finished in 23.5 s; without recovery it had not finished after 120 s.

questions.question: The wall that never moved was given up on after how many attempts?
options: It kept trying until the test ended
questions.explanation: The ladder was climbed three times and then the vehicle stopped and reported, after 31.2 s.

questions.question: Why does a car's ladder back up twice instead of spinning?
options: Spinning uses too much power
Spinning damages the tyres
The second back up goes further
A car cannot spin in place
questions.explanation: A rung the vehicle cannot do is left out. A differential drive or skid steer spins in place to look round; a car's ladder backs up again.

questions.question: Why does every behaviour have a time limit?
options: To keep the attempts evenly spaced
So the wait is always the longest step
To reset the stuck detector
A back up that is itself blocked would reverse for ever
questions.explanation: A recovery can be blocked too. With a limit the behaviour ends and the ladder moves on.
